profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer at Kroger
profile.summary:
Experienced software engineer with a passion for app modernization, cloud migrations, and cloud architecture.  Looking for ways to help organizations bring value to customers as often as possible using automation and Continuous Improvement.  Enthusiastic about leading by example and teaching others in an open, collaborative environment, with a particular interest in using Agile and DevOps concepts and techniques to help improve organizational processes and best practices.

I have extensive experience working directly with technical and business customers to deliver high quality enterprise solutions.  I am also very passionate about and experienced with Agile and Scrum methodologies and hold both PSM I and PSD I certifications.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Internal Responsibilities:
• Act as Team Lead within the Cloud & DevOps practice, guiding four direct reports with career and skill growth as well as meeting regularly to set goals and discuss progress
• Lead the organization of volunteer events within Insight; participated in organization of social and professional events
• Assist with pre-sales, SOW estimations, sales calls
• Perform technical screening for candidates in the Cloud & DevOps practice

For various clients:
• Manage existing platform infrastructure code using Terraform and Kubernetes
• Establish code standards for source code and CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps; work with other teams to improve the quality of the codebase
• Create YAML pipelines in Azure DevOps in order to have maintainable and repeatable releases for platform infrastructure
• Lead migration of source code repository and CI/CD deployment pipeline from GitLab to GitHub
• Create new deployment workflows using Azure DevOps for existing microservices
• Establish best practices for deployment standards and DevOps patterns within application team

positions.title: Senior II Consultant
positions.description:
Internal Responsibilities:
• Acted as Team Lead within the Applications & Infrastructure practice, guiding four direct reports with career and skill growth as well as meeting regularly to set goals and discuss progress
• Led the organization of volunteer events in Cincinnati; participated in organization of social and professional events
• Assisted with pre-sales, SOW estimations, sales calls
• Performed technical screening for candidates in the Applications & Infrastructure practice

For various clients:
• Developed highly customized solutions for multiple clients using C# and Microsoft .NET, SQL, Angular, MVC, and many other technologies and frameworks
• Lead development teams through the software development lifecycle and architected new solutions, helping drive best practices
• Guided clients through source code migration, implementation of Gitflow, and best practices for Agile and Scrum
• Implemented a distributed computing solution leveraging .NET and RabbitMQ
• Architected and developed solution to display real-time call metrics for display using the d3.js framework for data visualization
• Used Microsoft Azure to handle processing of large data sets from Azure Event Hubs for a custom IoT solution

positions.title: Student Research Assistant
positions.description: Conduct research in the Computer Science department regarding the detection and removal of malicious keylogging software.  Used knowledge of virtual machines and process monitoring software to detect changes in the file system.  Also utilized packet sniffing software to detect and analyze network traffic.

positions.title: Junior Developer
positions.description: Develop applications for implementation within a structure that communicates and uses data sources from EPIC healthcare systems.  Implemented several different applications using SQL queries to retrieve and manipulate data and the storage and transfer of that data.  Also utilized MonoTouch with the MonoDevelop IDE to develop applications for iOS in C#.

positions.title: Software Engineering Specialist II
positions.description: Create and manage webpages for www.nkyecd.com, along with configuration of a database to store and report on data entered by users.  ECD stores student demographic information, scores, and involvements.  This data is then used for reporting purposes by educators throughout Northern Kentucky.  Created new reports using Telerik software and controls.  Addition of features including updated controls and database schema.  C# code with ASP.NET pages and AJAX control are used to provide the interaction between the website and database.  Knowledge of version control and ticketing software.

volunteerExperiences.description: Worked with United Rehabilitation Services to develop changes to their existing portal used to track and manage company events, as well as manage volunteer applications using WordPress, PHP, and CSS.
